CORVUS CLOUD DATA RETENTION & DELETION POLICY (Support Reference Copy)
1. Account deletion requests are processed within 30 calendar days of the request date. During this window, the account is in a 'pending deletion' state: data is inaccessible to the user but not yet purged.
2. A pending deletion can be reversed if the user contacts support and explicitly requests reactivation before the 30-day window closes. After the window closes, deletion is permanent and irreversible.
3. Billing: any active subscription is cancelled immediately upon submission of a deletion request; no partial-period refund is issued for the remainder of a paid term, per the Terms of Service.
4. Business/Team accounts: deletion of a Team account requires confirmation from the account owner, not just any team member, and follows the same 30-day window once confirmed by the owner.
5. Legal holds: if an account is subject to a legal hold (e.g., active litigation, regulatory request), deletion is suspended until the hold is lifted, regardless of the 30-day window.
6. Communication: deletion-related confirmations (including reactivation requests) must be made through the account's registered email or the in-app support chat. A phone call alone can initiate a discussion but is not sufficient to action a reversal; a written request is always required.

SUPPORT CASE LOG
Account: personal plan, owner Naledi Mokoena
Deletion requested: Mar 1
Today's date: Mar 26 (25 days after the request)
Legal hold: none on file
Account type: personal (not a Team account)

Phone log, Mar 20: Naledi called in and verbally asked about reactivating, but was told a written request (email or chat) would be required to action it, per clause 6; no written request followed at that time.

Mar 24 message from Naledi (submitted via in-app chat): "Hi, I changed my mind, please reactivate my account, I still need the files in there for a work project."

Unrelated note on file: Naledi is also a member (not owner) of a separate Corvus Cloud Team account (ID T-2291) belonging to her employer; that Team account is not part of this deletion request and remains fully active throughout.

Agent note, Mar 26: Confirmed no legal hold. Confirmed the Mar 24 in-app chat message is a valid written request under clause 6, and falls within the 30-day pending-deletion window (day 25 of 30, counting from the Mar 1 request). Proceeding to reverse the deletion and restore full account access. No refund is owed for the subscription period that was already cancelled on Mar 1, per clause 3.

NOTICE OF CANCELLATION WITHIN COOLING-OFF PERIOD

To: Ampletask Billing Department
Re: Annual Plan purchased Nov 2, invoice #AT-6620, account email d.oyelaran@mailbox.com

Under Section 8 of your Terms of Service, subscribers may cancel within 14 days of purchase for a full refund, no questions asked. I purchased the annual plan on Nov 2 and am submitting this notice on Nov 12, which is within that 14-day window.

For context, I attempted to submit this request through the in-app cancellation flow on Nov 10, but the 'Cancel Subscription' button returned a generic error each time, so I am submitting this written notice instead as backup, along with a screenshot of the error (Appendix A). I also called your support line on Nov 11 and was told to expect a callback within 24 hours confirming the cancellation; as of this letter, no callback has been received.

I request cancellation of the subscription and a full refund of $89.99 to my original payment method. I am not requesting any partial credit or account retention -- a full cancellation and refund is what I'm asking for. Section 8 also states that refund requests submitted within the cooling-off period must be processed within 5 business days; I expect the refund to post by Nov 19 accordingly.

For clarity, this notice concerns only the Annual Plan on invoice #AT-6620. I separately maintain a month-to-month Ampletask Lite subscription on a different email address for personal use, which is not affected by this letter and should remain active exactly as is -- please do not cancel or modify that account when processing this request.

If I do not receive confirmation of both the cancellation and the refund timeline within 5 business days of this letter, I will dispute the $89.99 charge directly with my card issuer, which I would prefer to avoid if this can simply be processed per your own stated policy.

I've kept a timeline of every attempt for my own records: Nov 2 purchase, Nov 10 failed in-app attempt, Nov 11 phone call with no follow-up, and now this Nov 12 written notice. I'm raising this history not to be difficult, but because I want to avoid a situation where the 14-day window is later disputed on the grounds that I acted too late, when in fact I began trying to cancel two days before this letter.

Please confirm receipt of this notice by reply email.

Regards,
Damilola Oyelaran
